description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractDDataHandler that manages distributed data collections (specifically an ORMultiMap of ActorRef to some data type S) within an Akka cluster environment. It includes methods for reading, updating, removing subscribers by address, and handling subscription changes, with integration for metrics tracking.

classes.name: AbstractDDataHandler
classes.description: An abstract class for handling distributed data using Akka's Distributed Data module, supporting CRUD operations on a map of ActorRef to data, with metrics collection.

methods.name: abstract S approximate(String topic)
methods.description: Returns an approximate value for the given topic based on the data collected.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves ActorRefs that are subscribed to at least one of the given topics.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the current state of the distributed map from the Akka cluster with specified read consistency.

methods.name: removeAddress
methods.description: Removes all entries associated with a specified network address from the distributed map.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates entries for a specific subscriber with given topics, either replacing all or incrementally.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a specific subscriber from the distributed data map.

methods.name: receiveChanges
methods.description: Sets up subscription for changes in the distributed data to a recipient actor.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the Akka data key associated with this distributed data.

methods.name: getInitialValue
methods.description: Provides the initial value for the distributed map when none exists.
